_help: Game clip name -> source FBX (relative to 'Animations Mixamo'). Clips whose file is missing are skipped and keep the neutral pose, unless 'mirror_of' names a clip that exists, in which case that clip is mirrored left/right. Optional 'trim': [firstFrame, lastFrame] in source frames. 'strike' names the hand/foot/head that lands the hit: the frame where it reaches farthest from the hips becomes the contact point, which the game aligns with the attack's damage moment. 'contact': a source frame number overrides that guess. 'lift' scales upward hip motion (0 for air moves: the game's jump physics already lifts her). 'slide' scales the leftover horizontal hip motion. 'hold' repeats the last frame; 'then' lists more pieces played afterwards, each with its own file/trim and optional 'reverse', 'step' (use every Nth frame) and 'hold'. Rebuild with Tools\Animations\build.ps1.
_outfit_help: Outfits whose model was re-posed (see flatten_feet.py) get their own neutral pose re-fitted from the original in outfit_clip_folders.
